verses.transliteration: bə·nê p̄aš·ḥūr ’e·lep̄ mā·ṯa·yim ’ar·bā·‘îm wə·šiḇ·‘āh
verses.literal: the descendants of Pashhur 1,247 . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Pasur, mil duzentos e quarenta e sete.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י חָרִ֔ם אֶ֖לֶף וְשִׁבְעָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ḥā·rim ’e·lep̄ wə·šiḇ·‘āh ‘ā·śār
verses.literal: and the descendants of Harim 1,017 . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Harim, mil e dezessete.

verses.original: הַלְוִיִּ֑ם בְּנֵי־ יֵשׁ֧וּעַ וְקַדְמִיאֵ֛ל לִבְנֵ֥י הוֹדַוְיָ֖ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: hal·wî·yim bə·nê- yê·šū·a‘ wə·qaḏ·mî·’êl liḇ·nê hō·w·ḏaw·yāh šiḇ·‘îm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh
verses.literal: The Levites the descendants of Jeshua and Kadmiel through the line of Hodaviah 74 . . .
verses.literalPt: Os levitas: os filhos de Jesuá e Cadmiel, dos filhos de Hodavias, setenta e quatro.

verses.original: הַֽמְשֹׁרְרִ֑ים בְּנֵ֣י אָסָ֔ף מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ham·šō·rə·rîm bə·nê ’ā·sāp̄ mê·’āh ‘eś·rîm ū·šə·mō·nāh
verses.literal: The singers the descendants of Asaph 128 . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os cantores: os filhos de Asafe, cento e vinte e oito.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י הַשֹּֽׁעֲרִ֗ים בְּנֵי־ שַׁלּ֤וּם בְּנֵֽי־ אָטֵר֙ בְּנֵי־ טַלְמ֣וֹן בְּנֵי־ עַקּ֔וּב בְּנֵ֥י חֲטִיטָ֖א בְּנֵ֣י שֹׁבָ֑י הַכֹּ֕ל מֵאָ֖ה שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְתִשְׁעָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: bə·nê haš·šō·‘ă·rîm bə·nê- šal·lūm bə·nê- ’ā·ṭêr bə·nê- ṭal·mō·wn bə·nê- ‘aq·qūḇ bə·nê ḥă·ṭî·ṭā bə·nê šō·ḇāy hak·kōl mê·’āh šə·lō·šîm wə·ṯiš·‘āh
verses.literal: The gatekeepers the descendants of Shallum the descendants of Ater the descendants of Talmon the descendants of Akkub the descendants of Hatita and the descendants of Shobai 139 . . . . . . in all
verses.literalPt: Os filhos dos porteiros: os filhos de Salum, os filhos de Ater, os filhos de Talmom, os filhos de Acube, os filhos de Hatita, os filhos de Sobai; ao todo, cento e trinta e nove.

verses.original: הַנְּתִינִ֑ים בְּנֵי־ צִיחָ֥א בְנֵי־ חֲשׂוּפָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י טַבָּעֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: han·nə·ṯî·nîm bə·nê- ṣî·ḥā ḇə·nê- ḥă·śū·p̄ā bə·nê ṭab·bā·‘ō·wṯ
verses.literal: The temple servants the descendants of Ziha the descendants of Hasupha the descendants of Tabbaoth
verses.literalPt: Os netinins: os filhos de Zia, os filhos de Hasufa, os filhos de Tabaote,

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ קֵרֹ֥ס בְּֽנֵי־ סִֽיעֲהָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י פָדֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- qê·rōs bə·nê- sî·‘ă·hā bə·nê p̄ā·ḏō·wn
verses.literal: the descendants of Keros the descendants of Siaha the descendants of Padon
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Querós, os filhos de Siá, os filhos de Padom,

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ לְבָנָ֥ה בְנֵי־ חֲגָבָ֖ה בְּנֵ֥י עַקּֽוּב׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- lə·ḇā·nāh ḇə·nê- ḥă·ḡā·ḇāh bə·nê ‘aq·qūḇ
verses.literal: the descendants of Lebanah the descendants of Hagabah the descendants of Akkub
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Lebaná, os filhos de Hagaba, os filhos de Acube,

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ חָגָ֥ב בְּנֵי־ שַׁמְלַי בְּנֵ֥י חָנָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- ḥā·ḡāḇ bə·nê- šam·lay bə·nê ḥā·nān
verses.literal: the descendants of Hagab the descendants of Shalmai the descendants of Hanan
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Hagabe, os filhos de Sanlai, os filhos de Hanã,

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ גִדֵּ֥ל בְּנֵי־ גַ֖חַר בְּנֵ֥י רְאָיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- ḡid·dêl bə·nê- ḡa·ḥar bə·nê rə·’ā·yāh
verses.literal: the descendants of Giddel the descendants of Gahar the descendants of Reaiah
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Gidel, os filhos de Gaar, os filhos de Reaías,

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ רְצִ֥ין בְּנֵי־ נְקוֹדָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י גַזָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- rə·ṣîn bə·nê- nə·qō·w·ḏā bə·nê ḡaz·zām
verses.literal: the descendants of Rezin the descendants of Nekoda the descendants of Gazzam
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Rezim, os filhos de Necoda, os filhos de Gazão,

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ עֻזָּ֥א בְנֵי־ פָסֵ֖חַ בְּנֵ֥י בֵסָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- ‘uz·zā ḇə·nê- p̄ā·sê·aḥ bə·nê ḇê·sāy
verses.literal: the descendants of Uzza the descendants of Paseah the descendants of Besai
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Uzá, os filhos de Paseá, os filhos de Besai,

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ אַסְנָ֥ה בְנֵי־ מְעִינִים בְּנֵ֥י נְפִיסִים׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- ’as·nāh ḇə·nê- mə·ʿī·nīm bə·nê nə·p̄ī·sīm
verses.literal: the descendants of Asnah the descendants of Meunim the descendants of Nephusim
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Asna, os filhos dos meunitas, os filhos dos nefuseus,

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ בַקְבּ֥וּק בְּנֵי־ חֲקוּפָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י חַרְחֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- ḇaq·būq bə·nê- ḥă·qū·p̄ā bə·nê ḥar·ḥūr
verses.literal: the descendants of Bakbuk the descendants of Hakupha the descendants of Harhur
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Bacbuque, os filhos de Hacufa, os filhos de Harur,

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ בַצְל֥וּת בְּנֵי־ מְחִידָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י חַרְשָֽׁא׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- ḇaṣ·lūṯ bə·nê- mə·ḥî·ḏā bə·nê ḥar·šā
verses.literal: the descendants of Bazluth the descendants of Mehida the descendants of Harsha
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Bazlute, os filhos de Meída, os filhos de Harsa,

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ בַרְק֥וֹס בְּֽנֵי־ סִֽיסְרָ֖א בְּנֵי־ תָֽמַח׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- ḇar·qō·ws bə·nê- sî·sə·rā bə·nê- ṯā·maḥ
verses.literal: the descendants of Barkos the descendants of Sisera the descendants of Temah
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Barcos, os filhos de Sísera, os filhos de Tama.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י נְצִ֖יחַ בְּנֵ֥י חֲטִיפָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê nə·ṣî·aḥ bə·nê ḥă·ṭî·p̄ā
verses.literal: the descendants of Neziah and the descendants of Hatipha
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Neziá, os filhos de Hatifa,

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה בְּנֵי־ סֹטַ֥י בְּנֵי־ הַסֹּפֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֥י פְרוּדָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ‘aḇ·ḏê šə·lō·mōh bə·nê- sō·ṭay bə·nê- has·sō·p̄e·reṯ bə·nê p̄ə·rū·ḏā
verses.literal: The descendants of the servants of Solomon the descendants of Sotai the descendants of Hassophereth the descendants of Peruda
verses.literalPt: Os filhos dos servos de Salomão; os filhos de Sotai, os filhos de Soferete, os filhos de Peruda,

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ יַעְלָ֥ה בְנֵי־ דַרְק֖וֹן בְּנֵ֥י גִדֵּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- ya‘·lāh ḇə·nê- ḏar·qō·wn bə·nê ḡid·dêl
verses.literal: the descendants of Jaala the descendants of Darkon the descendants of Giddel
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Jaalá, os filhos de Darcom, os filhos de Gidel,

verses.original: בְּנֵ֧י שְׁפַטְיָ֣ה בְנֵֽי־ חַטִּ֗יל בְּנֵ֛י פֹּכֶ֥רֶת הַצְּבָיִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י אָמִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê šə·p̄aṭ·yāh ḇə·nê- ḥaṭ·ṭîl bə·nê pō·ḵe·reṯ haṣ·ṣə·ḇā·yîm bə·nê ’ā·mî
verses.literal: the descendants of Shephatiah the descendants of Hattil the descendants of Pochereth-hazzebaim and the descendants of Ami
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Sefatias, os filhos de Hatil, os filhos de Poquerete-Hazebaim, os filhos de Ami.

verses.original: כָּ֨ל־ הַנְּתִינִ֔ים וּבְנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס
verses.transliteration: kāl- han·nə·ṯî·nîm ū·ḇə·nê ‘aḇ·ḏê šə·lō·mōh šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ tiš·‘îm ū·šə·nā·yim
verses.literal: The temple servants and descendants of the servants of Solomon numbered 392 . . . . . . . . . in all
verses.literalPt: Todos os netinins, e os filhos dos servos de Salomão, trezentos e noventa e dois.

verses.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה הָֽעֹלִים֙ מִתֵּ֥ל מֶ֙לַח֙ תֵּ֣ל חַרְשָׁ֔א כְּר֥וּב אַדָּ֖ן אִמֵּ֑ר וְלֹ֣א יָֽכְל֗וּ לְהַגִּ֤יד בֵּית־ אֲבוֹתָם֙ וְזַרְעָ֔ם אִ֥ם מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh hā·‘ō·lîm mit·têl me·laḥ têl ḥar·šā kə·rūḇ ’ad·dān ’im·mêr wə·lō yā·ḵə·lū lə·hag·gîḏ bêṯ- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām wə·zar·‘ām ’im mî·yiś·rā·’êl hêm
verses.literal: The following came up from Tel-melah Tel-harsha Cherub Addan and Immer but they could not . . . prove that their families . . . were descended . . . from Israel . . .
verses.literalPt: Também estes subiram de Tel-Melá e Tel-Harsa, Querube, Adã e Imer; porém não puderam provar que as suas famílias e a sua linhagem eram de Israel.

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ דְלָיָ֥ה בְנֵי־ טוֹבִיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י נְקוֹדָ֑א שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- ḏə·lā·yāh ḇə·nê- ṭō·w·ḇî·yāh bə·nê nə·qō·w·ḏā šêš mê·’ō·wṯ ḥă·miš·šîm ū·šə·nā·yim
verses.literal: the descendants of Delaiah the descendants of Tobiah and the descendants of Nekoda 652 in all . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Delaías, os filhos de Tobias, os filhos de Necoda, seiscentos e cinqüenta e dois.

verses.original: וּמִבְּנֵי֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים בְּנֵ֥י חֳבַיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י הַקּ֑וֹץ בְּנֵ֣י בַרְזִלַּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָ֠קַח מִבְּנ֞וֹת בַּרְזִלַּ֤י הַגִּלְעָדִי֙ אִשָּׁ֔ה וַיִּקָּרֵ֖א עַל־ שְׁמָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mib·bə·nê hak·kō·hă·nîm bə·nê ḥo·ḇay·yāh bə·nê haq·qō·wṣ bə·nê ḇar·zil·lay ’ă·šer lā·qaḥ mib·bə·nō·wṯ bar·zil·lay hag·gil·‘ā·ḏî ’iš·šāh way·yiq·qā·rê ‘al- šə·mām
verses.literal: And from among the priests the descendants of Hobaiah the descendants of Hakkoz and the descendants of Barzillai who had married . . . a daughter of Barzillai the Gileadite and was called by their name
verses.literalPt: E dos filhos dos sacerdotes: os filhos de Habaías, os filhos de Coz, os filhos de Barzilai, que tomou mulher das filhas de Barzilai, o gileadita, e que foi chamado do seu nome.

verses.original: אֵ֗לֶּה בִּקְשׁ֧וּ כְתָבָ֛ם הַמִּתְיַחְשִׂ֖ים וְלֹ֣א נִמְצָ֑אוּ וַֽיְגֹאֲל֖וּ מִן־ הַכְּהֻנָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh biq·šū ḵə·ṯā·ḇām ham·miṯ·yaḥ·śîm wə·lō nim·ṣā·’ū way·ḡō·’ă·lū min- hak·kə·hun·nāh
verses.literal: These men searched for their family records . . . but they could not find them and so were excluded from the priesthood as unclean
verses.literalPt: Estes procuraram o seu registro entre os que estavam arrolados nas genealogias, mas não se acharam nelas; assim, por imundos, foram excluídos do sacerdócio.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הַתִּרְשָׁ֙תָא֙ לָהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ יֹאכְל֖וּ מִקֹּ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים עַ֛ד עֲמֹ֥ד כֹּהֵ֖ן לְאוּרִ֥ים וּלְתֻמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hat·tir·šā·ṯā lā·hem ’ă·šer lō- yō·ḵə·lū miq·qō·ḏeš haq·qo·ḏā·šîm ‘aḏ ‘ă·mōḏ kō·hên lə·’ū·rîm ū·lə·ṯum·mîm
verses.literal: The governor ordered them not to eat the most holy things . . . until . . . there was a priest to consult the Urim and Thummim
verses.literalPt: E o governador lhes disse que não comessem das coisas consagradas, até que houvesse sacerdote com Urim e com Tumim.

verses.original: כָּל־ הַקָּהָ֖ל כְּאֶחָ֑ד אַרְבַּ֣ע רִבּ֔וֹא אַלְפַּ֖יִם שְׁלֹשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת שִׁשִּֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- haq·qā·hāl kə·’e·ḥāḏ ’ar·ba‘ rib·bō·w ’al·pa·yim šə·lōš- mê·’ō·wṯ šiš·šîm
verses.literal: The whole assembly numbered 42,360 . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Toda esta congregação junta foi de quarenta e dois mil trezentos e sessenta,

verses.original: מִ֠לְּבַד עַבְדֵיהֶ֤ם וְאַמְהֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ אֵ֔לֶּה שִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וְשִׁבְעָ֑ה וְלָהֶ֛ם מְשֹׁרְרִ֥ים וּֽמְשֹׁרְר֖וֹת מָאתָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: mil·lə·ḇaḏ ‘aḇ·ḏê·hem wə·’am·hō·ṯê·hem ’êl·leh šiḇ·‘aṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ šə·lō·šîm wə·šiḇ·‘āh wə·lā·hem mə·šō·rə·rîm ū·mə·šō·rə·rō·wṯ mā·ṯā·yim
verses.literal: in addition to . . . their 7,337 . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . menservants and maidservants as well as their 200 male and female singers
verses.literalPt: Afora os seus servos e as suas servas, que foram sete mil trezentos e trinta e sete; também tinha duzentos cantores e cantoras.

verses.original: סוּסֵיהֶ֕ם שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֑ה פִּרְדֵיהֶ֕ם מָאתַ֖יִם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: sū·sê·hem šə·ḇa‘ mê·’ō·wṯ šə·lō·šîm wə·šiš·šāh pir·ḏê·hem mā·ṯa·yim ’ar·bā·‘îm wa·ḥă·miš·šāh
verses.literal: They had 736 . . . . . . . . . horses 245 . . . . . . mules
verses.literalPt: Os seus cavalos, setecentos e trinta e seis; os seus mulos, duzentos e quarenta e cinco;

verses.original: גְּמַ֨לֵּיהֶ֔ם אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֑ה חֲמֹרִ֕ים שֵׁ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: gə·mal·lê·hem ’ar·ba‘ mê·’ō·wṯ šə·lō·šîm wa·ḥă·miš·šāh ḥă·mō·rîm šê·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm šə·ḇa‘ mê·’ō·wṯ wə·‘eś·rîm
verses.literalPt: Os seus camelos, quatrocentos e trinta e cinco; os jumentos, seis mil setecentos e vinte.

verses.original: וּמֵרָאשֵׁי֙ הָֽאָב֔וֹת בְּבוֹאָ֕ם לְבֵ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הִֽתְנַדְּבוּ֙ לְבֵ֣ית הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים לְהַעֲמִיד֖וֹ עַל־ מְכוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mê·rā·šê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ bə·ḇō·w·’ām lə·ḇêṯ Yah·weh ’ă·šer bî·rū·šā·lim hiṯ·nad·də·ḇū lə·ḇêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·ha·‘ă·mî·ḏōw ‘al- mə·ḵō·w·nōw
verses.literal: When they arrived at the house of the LORD in Jerusalem some of the heads of the families gave freewill offerings to rebuild the house of God on its original site
verses.literalPt: E alguns dos chefes dos pais, vindo à casa do SENHOR, que habita em Jerusalém, deram ofertas voluntárias para a casa de Deus, para a estabelecerem no seu lugar.

verses.original: כְּכֹחָ֗ם נָתְנוּ֮ לְאוֹצַ֣ר הַמְּלָאכָה֒ זָהָ֗ב דַּרְכְּמוֹנִים֙ שֵׁשׁ־ רִבֹּ֣אות וָאֶ֔לֶףס וְכֶ֕סֶף מָנִ֖ים חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֑ים וְכָתְנֹ֥ת כֹּהֲנִ֖ים מֵאָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kə·ḵō·ḥām nā·ṯə·nū lə·’ō·w·ṣar ham·mə·lā·ḵāh zā·hāḇ dar·kə·mō·w·nîm šêš- rib·bō·wṯ wå̄·ʾɛ·lɛ·p̄s wə·ḵe·sep̄ mā·nîm ḥă·mê·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·ḵā·ṯə·nōṯ kō·hă·nîm mê·’āh
verses.literal: According to their ability they gave to the treasury for this work 61,000 . . . . . . darics of gold 5,000 . . . minas of silver and 100 priestly garments
verses.literalPt: Conforme as suas posses, deram para o tesouro da obra, em ouro, sessenta e uma mil dracmas, e em prata cinco mil libras, e cem vestes sacerdotais.

verses.original: וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְ֠הַלְוִיִּם וּֽמִן־ הָעָ֞ם וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֧ים וְהַשּׁוֹעֲרִ֛ים וְהַנְּתִינִ֖ים בְּעָרֵיהֶ֑ם וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּעָרֵיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yê·šə·ḇū hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·hal·wî·yim ū·min- hā·‘ām wə·ham·šō·rə·rîm wə·haš·šō·w·‘ă·rîm wə·han·nə·ṯî·nîm bə·‘ā·rê·hem wə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl bə·‘ā·rê·hem
verses.literal: So the priests the Levites the singers the gatekeepers and the temple servants along with some of the people settled in their own towns and the rest of the Israelites settled in their towns
verses.literalPt: E habitaram os sacerdotes e os levitas, e alguns do povo, tanto os cantores, como os porteiros, e os netinins, nas suas cidades; como também todo o Israel nas suas cidades.
